content.text: Where do I find store hours? You are here: Target Help Search Results Where do I find store hours? search help Where do I find store hours? Target App Find the store icon under the Account tab, the store hours are listed below your store name. If you are looking for the weekly hours, select Change and then select the "i" icon, and then select to “i” icon under Store hours to display the full week.If you want to know other local store hours, you can select the "i" icon on the listed stores or search for city, state, ZIP code for other stores. Target.com Navigate to the Target.com home page.In the upper right hand side of the Target.com home page, select Find stores.Enter a ZIP code, or city and state, and then Find store to review a local store list.Underneath your desired store, select Store info to review the full week’s hours and services. Was this information helpful?
